title: External Methods Output
description: section-ir-0.15 dedicated external stage: the external prior-art METHODS this paper builds on or compares its own method against, swept from the paper's prose. These records feed materialize_external_methods, which mints the external Method nodes the internal-only census no longer emits; the relation pass then draws one builds_on/compares_to edge per minted node.

name.description: The single most specific NAMED external prior-art method/model/architecture this paper relates its own method to (e.g. 'Transformer', 'ResNet', 'BERT', 'PointNet++'). NOT a generic paradigm ('attention', 'deep learning'), NOT a dataset/benchmark/metric, NOT apparatus (optimizer/sampler/scoring model), NOT this paper's own contribution or its components.

relation.description: builds_on = THIS paper's own contribution EXTENDS / derives from / adapts / generalizes this prior method (lineage — it modifies X). uses = THIS paper depends on this external method as a building block (a backbone, a base model, a reused technique) WITHOUT extending it (it adopts X as-is — 'we use X as the base model', 'we adopt the X backbone', 'we implement X'). compared_against = THIS paper evaluates its own method experimentally against this prior method as a baseline, or substantively argues against its method. Pick the most specific: extends -> builds_on; merely depends on -> uses; only a comparison baseline -> compared_against.

cite_key.description: The in-text citation marker attached to this method in the prose, exactly as written (e.g. '12', 'Vaswani2017'). Empty string if the method is named with no inline citation marker.

evidence.description: A short verbatim span from the paper stating the relationship (e.g. 'we build our model on top of the Transformer [12]'). Must show THIS paper as the actor that builds on / compares against the named method.
